answer: Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the violet queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 250 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the vine. The pulse index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 341 account operation therefore ties up 20 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
